user_target: At least 80 percent overall exact text, not 80 percent in every group

primary.metric: all characters and symbols exactly equal; rejected positives count wrong
primary.composition: original v4 stress composer and text-length schedule unchanged
primary.selection_rank: overall exact accuracy, then accepted precision, then fewer invalid false accepts

separate_quality_flags.old_public_regression: 607 previous public lowercase cases, 405 legacy cases and 44 invalid cases reported separately

supplemental_native_context.role: separate diagnostic; never mixed into primary 500 denominator
supplemental_native_context.source: contiguous annotated cells from the same reserved source pages
supplemental_native_context.image_policy: identity transform, single native image rectangle, uniform resize and letterbox; no individual cell pasting
supplemental_native_context.label_policy: original six-bit sequence; v4 literal token transcription only where grammar-valid, not translation of Chinese source text
supplemental_native_context.coverage_policy: report available native groups and exclusions; never synthesize missing capital/number groups

data_scope: source-disjoint recomposed public flatbed scans; not physical-phone-camera validation
known_limitations: Primary recompositions have artificial borders and page/shadow discontinuities
Random token strings differ from real vocabulary frequencies
18 old TEST pages are development-observed and cannot be final holdout again
Punctuation grammar remains bounded; decimals, signed numbers, spaces and quotes are outside scope
final_holdout_policy: Reserve source pages before labels/inference; freeze method/checkpoint using development validation only; one final evaluation
development_policy: Reuse existing TRAIN and validation by absolute path and SHA256, without copying images/manifests; old observed TEST remains historical only and is not added to gradients
